MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Frankie Valli & The 4 Seasons feels especially natural after AM Gold: The Mid-'60s and Simon & Garfunkel because I am looking for familiar older pop songs collected together.",
    "Fleetwood Mac and Queen hits collections fit my interest in The Cars and classic rock compilations, while It's the Girls! connects with the older vocal repertoire I enjoyed on Cheek to Cheek."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Adele's albums and Stronger feel less relevant today because my listening has leaned toward older songs and retrospective collections; my interest in Born This Way does not make every contemporary pop album appealing.",
    "Blake Shelton's collection has the hits format I like, but that alone does not give me the same connection as familiar older pop and classic rock. To All The Girls... also lacks a clear connection to what I want now.",
    "I cannot tell whether Title matches my interests from that name alone, so I would pass rather than assume it contains music I want."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My occasional interest in contemporary pop seems to have been stretched into a broader appetite for contemporary pop albums.",
    "A greatest-hits label seems to count too much on its own; the artist, era, and songs still need to connect with my listening."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated choices of older pop and classic rock collections matter more to today's decision than any single contemporary album in my history.",
    "Familiar songs gathered across an artist's career are particularly appealing right now, which is why Frankie Valli and Fleetwood Mac stand out even among other plausible choices."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my interest in hits collections but gave too little weight to the familiar older pop and classic rock I want most right now."
}
